use_cases.title: Quick read-only API exploration
use_cases.scenario: A student team needs immediate access to a shared Cisco environment to practice safe read-only API requests. Administrative changes are not required, and the team cannot wait for provisioning.

use_cases.title: Private configuration testing
use_cases.scenario: A development team must test configuration changes with administrative access in a private environment. The team can schedule access, use a VPN, and accept setup time.

use_cases.title: Guided API concept practice
use_cases.scenario: A beginner needs structured, step-by-step learning content before attempting an independent API activity. The immediate goal is guided practice rather than access to administrative devices.

use_cases.title: Reusable automation example
use_cases.scenario: A developer wants to examine community and Cisco-maintained code repositories for an existing network-automation use case before designing a new solution.
